steps.en: Install the CLI and scaffold a crew project
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，生成一个团队项目
steps.code: uv tool install crewai · crewai create crew <project_name>

steps.en: Describe each agent's role, goal, backstory and tools, then the ordered tasks
steps.zh: 写每个智能体的角色、目标、背景和工具，再按顺序列任务

steps.en: Put your model key in .env and start the crew
steps.zh: 把模型密钥写进 .env，启动团队

steps.en: Builds each agent's prompt from its role and hands tasks out in process order
steps.zh: 用角色信息拼出各自的提示词，按流程顺序分派任务

steps.en: Each agent loops over the model and its tools until it meets expected_output
steps.zh: 每个智能体反复调模型和工具，直到产出符合 expected_output

steps.en: Passes each result on as context and writes the final output
steps.zh: 把每步结果作为上下文往下传，写出最终产物

value.en: A multi-role job runs as a team you described, not one prompt that forgets half the work
value.zh: 多角色的活按你描述的团队分工跑完，不再是一个丢三落四的大提示词

sources: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI#2-setting-up-your-crew (crewai create crew <project_name>; agents/*.jsonc; crew.jsonc; expected_output; context)
https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI#3-running-your-crew (.env keys; crewai install; crewai run; output/report.md; sequential vs hierarchical process)
